title: 1RB1LC_1RC0RF_1RD0LB_1RE0LD_1LF---_0RA1LA: the digit map's closed form is a rational base 31/10 expansion of 22, and 10^8 exact steps look random
text: Lean proves the exact identity 10kxk + 31Σ31k−1−i10idi = 31kx0 + 10Σ31k−1−i10iKi (orbit_identity), and that for every k the first k values of r re-encode the start mod 10k, every list occurring (rlist_onto). A divide-and-conquer run follows the orbit of 22 exactly for 108 steps: all 59 blocks of r values occur, chi-square |z| ≤ 2.03, halt chance from level 2 still about 6%. No closed form skips steps, so the machine stays open.
